verdict.rationale: Datadog has two first-party docs sections aimed at in-product AI insights: Bits AI, an AI assistant, and Watchdog, its automated anomaly and insight detection. Together they indicate that AI-generated insights from user data are delivered inside the platform. The pack only gives page titles, though, so the depth of the capability cannot be confirmed. Missing for 10: detail on which insights and suggestions Bits AI and Watchdog actually produce, and independent or hands-on corroboration of their usefulness.
